messages:
Emma (docs): heads-up: opened a tiny hotfix PR to docs/known-issues to add the outage statuspage link + a short workaround note. Need a quick review and merge today if CI preview passes.
Sam (oncall): can you paste the statuspage URL? i want to link to the exact incident entry.
Emma (docs): sure — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-18-region-outage
Marta (docs-reviewer): pinging reviewers. i'll try to take a look in 15. is this just a link+one-paragraph workaround?
Emma (docs): yep. changed the known-issues anchor, added a step-by-step workaround for degraded KV cache behavior, and added the statuspage link + tl;dr at top.
ci-bot: docs-preview build triggered: PR #4217 — running checks
Joel (platform): FYI the preview failed earlier for relative links causing 404s. if you used a relative anchor, preview might break. prefer absolute here.
Emma (docs): i swapped to absolute and updated the anchor name to "kv-cache-eviction-workaround" — pushing now.
ci-bot: docs-preview failed: 1 broken link in docs/known-issues.md -> ./legacy/known-issues.md#kv
Ryan (sre): that legacy page was nuked in the migration. quick fix: point to /docs/known-issues.md#kv-cache-eviction-workaround or remove the old ref. Emma can you grep for the old path?
Emma (docs): yep, doing a search-and-replace across mkdocs sources, will push a single commit with the fix.
Marta (docs-reviewer): will review after the fix. if it's just link fixes + a single paragraph, i can approve.
Emma (docs): pushed commit — removed legacy ref and updated all anchors. CI re-run.
ci-bot: docs-preview succeeded: deploy-preview-4217 — https://deploy-preview-4217--redwood-docs.netlify.app/docs/known-issues/#kv-cache-eviction-workaround
Sam (oncall): checked the preview. statuspage link resolves and the workaround steps look clear. can we add a short note: "temporary workaround — do not use permissive batching"? that prevented spike in our case.
Emma (docs): added one-line note and pushed. small wording tweak only.
Marta (docs-reviewer): LGTM — approved
Joel (platform): approved. want me to merge and backport to stable branch?
Emma (docs): yes please merge main -> stable after merge. i'll open a backport PR if needed but platform can do it.
deploy-bot: PR #4217 merged by Joel. backport PR #4218 created for release/stable.
Emma (docs): thanks all. filed a follow-up task to add this workaround to the runbook and mark the incident link in the changelog.
Sam (oncall): thanks emma — saved me a call to customer success who were asking for the exact steps.
Ryan (sre): leaving a note in postmortem referencing the docs change.
